messages:
jamie: Supplier sent an unexpected manifest change — our June reserved shipment split, big tranche pushed to late July.
nora: Which reservation IDs and new ETAs?
supply-bot: Manifest update: reservations [RC-9790, RC-9791, RC-9792] orig ETA 2026-06-12. New: mini-tranche 100 units -> 2026-06-20; main 260 units -> 2026-07-29. Note: "logistics delay" on carrier side.
devin: Which customers rely on those reservations? Any hard SLA dates?
jamie: Quick map: RC-9790 -> FinLedger (120 GPUs, launch 2026-06-18); RC-9791 -> internal buffer 80 GPUs; RC-9792 -> Marketplace pilot 160 GPUs.
leo: Mini-tranche still misses FinLedger demo. Ops can short-burst marketplace but cost jumps.
anya: Legal: don't promise credits in external comms. We can say "remediation per SLA" and coordinate privately.
devin: Options: (A) cross-region borrow 70 GPUs (adds ~24h ops), (B) marketplace burst 120 GPUs (expensive), (C) ask supplier for airfreight/early release.
jamie: @supply-bot escalate for airfreight and early-release confirmation; ask for written ETA and surcharge.
supply-bot: Escalation sent to supplier AE. Reply expected within 3h.
leo: We have 50 GPUs in staging that can be freed in 12h. That plus early-release could cover FinLedger.
anya: If accepting mixed SKUs, document acceptance and run quick compatibility tests. Legal will draft a short consent clause.
jamie: Action list: @devin inventory exact firmware/SKU needs for FinLedger; @leo free staging GPUs; @supply-bot follow supplier; @anya prep legal blurb; @nora draft cautious customer note.
(devin later): Confirmed FinLedger requires 80GB-class SKUs; mixed 80GB SKUs acceptable with firmware>=2025.8.
supply-bot: Update: supplier committed to release 80 units early and is checking airfreight for an extra 60.
jamie: That plus 50 staging and marketplace burst of 10 should cover the launch. Hold comms until we have written confirmation for the remainder.
nora: Draft ready: "We're responding with mitigations to keep your launch on track; we'll follow up with details by EOD." Legal reviewed.
jamie: Closing for now. Keep ticket updated with manifests and bills of lading. Postmortem planned after July windows settle.
